headcount.note: Exactly ten courtiers (diamonds) + ten royal children (hearts). Soldiers, guests, Knave, King and Queen have their own cards.
headcount.quote: next the ten courtiers; these were ornamented all over with diamonds, and walked two and two, as the soldiers did. After these came the royal children; there were ten of them, and the little dears came jumping merrily along hand in hand, in couples: they were all ornamented with hearts.

gender_note.reason: Mixed group, not stated in source. Designed: courtiers 5 men + 5 women (ladies and gentlemen of the court walking two and two as couples); royal children 5 girls + 5 boys (walking hand in hand in couples). Female 10 / male 10 — 'female' is recorded as the nominal value only because the field requires one; use gender_mix and subgroup split.

default_outfit_tone: Courtiers: ivory card panels with red diamond pips over scarlet-and-gold court dress, jewel-like red diamond ornaments everywhere. Children: ivory card tunics with crimson heart pips over crimson-and-white children's dress with heart appliqués. Both share the crimson-and-cream lattice card-back.

default_outfit_tone_source.reason: Ornament motifs sourced (ch008-p11); colours and cuts designed; details owned by 06-art/costume.

period_silhouette.value: Courtiers: 1862 court dress (crinolines, tail coats) flattened by card panels. Children: 1862 children's dress (short crinolined skirts with pantalettes; boys' tunic suits).

variation_rules: Courtiers walk two and two; children skip hand in hand in couples (boy-girl pairs).
No royal child may be as tall as or resemble Alice (no blue dress, no long fair loose hair on any girl).
Children's hearts are crimson; courtiers' diamonds are brighter scarlet — the two reds must not merge in a wide shot.
Procession order fixed by ch008-p11: soldiers, courtiers, children, guests, Knave, King and Queen.

doubling.reason: Not part of any H1 ruling 5.3 B doubling pair.

prompt_summary_en: Victorian 1862 royal procession: ten elegant courtiers, men and women walking two by two in scarlet-and-gold court dress with flat ivory playing-card panels covered in red diamond pips and red diamond ornaments, followed by ten small children aged 5 to 9 skipping hand in hand in pairs, wearing ivory card tunics with crimson heart pips over crimson-and-white dresses and tunic suits with heart appliqués, garden lawn, realistic period drama, human actors
